coding.definition: Code repository investigation, code review, and implementation.
parent_responsibility: For implementation tasks, make sure the task you spawn is verifiable on your side;
run relevant unit tests in your own execution environment;
run the end-to-end tests defined by the task.

medium.prompt: Inspect the relevant code and explain your findings.
Implement the delegated change and verify it with appropriate tests.

research.definition: Information collection, reasoning, mathematics, and summarization. Code repo excluded.
parent_responsibility: Check that findings answer the delegated question and are supported by the
available evidence. Keep the task and its interpretation neutral and specific.

general.definition: Tasks outside these categories; normally the main thread.
